about: Each case names its rule set by digest; ruleSets holds each one as the platform serves it, at the case's version (the newest where it names none). An interpreter evaluates a case's settings against its rule set and must give exactly its findings, in order: for each setting in turn, each rule that holds, in the rule set's order, once per rule, name, path and line. Regenerate ruleSets with -Dci-rules.write=true; findings are written by hand.
